Entry White Cloak of the Kingsguard The white robe means that the royal guards give up private inheritance, marriage and original family interests to protect the monarch throughout their lives. The court praises his glory, the family may lose its heir, and the White Robe himself must endure the most acute contradiction between his personal judgment and the king's orders. Whether it is valid depends on who can grant the rights, collect the consideration, and actually make the judgment come to fruition in the event of default.
